I know many of you already know about suboxone, but when I was deep into my opiate use I had never heard of it. It's not exactly new, it's been around since 2003.

I'm glad I did find out because I've been using it for three years and it saved my life. I simply couldn't afford dope anymore, I couldn't sustain r hustle to keep a bit of money going. I was done with life and being dope sick everyday was pushing me to suicide.

When I started suboxone I wasn't happy about it, I wanted to keep using dope. But I quickly found out the suboxone freed me from my worst feeling of being dope sick. Now I could live life normally and I could still get high if I wanted to. But I decided that I didn't need to anymore. I quit dope, weed, cigarettes and alcohol. I'm much more healthy and don't ever worry about money. I'm only saying this because I hope someone reads it and thinks, wow I want that too.

Now suboxone is expensive. Most doctors charge cash for all visits. 100-300 per visit depending on the doctor. The prescription itself can cost between 200-500 depending on what the doctor gives you.

50 suboxone strips = $500 cash

50 generic suboxone tablets = $200 cash

I've heard that Bunavil is cheaper.

If you have insurance you might be able to pay a co-pay or at least pay cash until you reach your deductible then pay a copay. I have state Medicaid and don't pay anything, totally recommend it!

Suboxone doctors also drug test, some all the time and some hardly ever. Your first few visits will be tested for sure.

OK that's all I have to say for now, if anyone any questions please message me or whatever.
